items.text: Ashton Jeanty questionable (foot/ankle); Raiders elevated RB Roman Hemby from practice squad.
items.why: DNP Friday after limited Thursday with added foot tag; coach says will do best to play.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Hemby/Washington workload spike as lead back.

items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed him he will be inactive for Sunday vs Lions as details complete. Houston among teams with interest.
items.why: Trade being finalized; team deactivating him pending deal.
items.implication: No Week 5 production; long-term destination TBD, likely boosts remaining AZ pass-catchers short-term.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Michael Wilson and Trey McBride; Bourne opportunity noted by analysts.

items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT for Week 5 (hamstring) along with DeVonta Smith and Hollywood Brown for Eagles.
items.why: Final injury report; missed practices with hamstring.
items.implication: Eagles RB/WR corps thinned significantly for London game vs JAX.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup RB elevation and remaining WR/TE target share uptick (Goedert cleared).

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT for Week 5 (left ankle).
items.implication: Ravens QB downgrade to Huntley; impacts all skill players' ceilings.
items.opportunity: Potential checkdown/volume shifts to Andrews/Likely/Henry but overall offense downgrade.

items.text: Steelers placed WR Michael Pittman Jr. on IR (foot); misses minimum four games.
items.implication: Extended absence; PIT WR room reshuffle.
items.opportunity: DK Metcalf and other Steelers pass-catchers sustained target increase.

items.text: MHJ had only 5 catches in 4 games and was not a real factor; with inactive/trade, it is Kendrick Bourne season in AZ (jokingly Mazda Marv to Kia Kendrick).
items.why: Low recent production (5/4 games); absence opens clear path for Wilson/Bourne.
items.implication: Wilson primary beneficiary already trending; Bourne sleeper bump.
items.opportunity: Wilson routes/targets/red-zone expand further vs DET.

items.why: Final injury report; second straight miss.
items.implication: Jets RB committee shifts fully to backups.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup carries and receiving work increase.

items.implication: WAS WR targets redistribute; McLaurin Q but higher share if both out.
items.opportunity: Terry McLaurin and secondary WRs/TE target bump.

items.implication: LAC WR depth thinned; McConkey Q.
items.opportunity: Ladd McConkey and other Chargers WRs target share up if active.

items.text: Jayden Daniels, Chris Olave, Dallas Goedert, Jeremiyah Love listed IN (cleared).
items.why: Final injury report clears after upgrades/full practices.
items.implication: Full or near-full roles expected; removes prior uncertainty.
items.opportunity: Normal snap/route/target shares restored; Daniels start confirmed.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love not on final injury report (ankle maintenance); ETR projects him 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier with expected bigger workload after Week 4 criticism.
items.why: Cleared final report; media/fan pressure on prior low usage may expand role; full-go comments.
items.implication: Strong RB start candidate; clear lead over Allgeier in projections.
items.opportunity: Expanded carries/snaps/routes vs DET; goal-line potential.
items.conflict: Ankle maintenance risk remains if long year fatigue hits.

items.text: Levitan flags multi-risk stack for Malik Nabers long-term: knee issue, lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, boomer coaching staff (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman).
items.why: Sore knee (DNP), post-halftime target frustration, stacked downside factors beyond this week.
items.implication: Caution on ROS valuation despite talent; monitor practice/usage closely.
items.opportunity: Still startable short-term if healthy but elevated volatility.
items.conflict: Great player talent vs cumulative risk factors.

items.text: Berry LOVES Nico Collins (WR8 vs TEN) for volume/red-zone/matchup and Chase Brown (RB5 @ MIA) for workload vs soft run D; also Michael Wilson, Christian Watson, Isaiah Likely.
items.why: Target-hogs + favorable matchups/defenses carved by RBs/WRs; Collins red-zone volume.
items.implication: Strong start recommendations; Wilson boosted further by MHJ inactive.
items.opportunity: High snap/target/carry shares in positive game scripts.

items.text: Berry HATES Jordan Addison (injury/matchup), Mark Andrews, Cam Skattebo, Tony Pollard (efficiency/game env), Jalen Hurts (rough stretch/banged line vs JAX).
items.why: Tough matchups, thin roles, poor recent efficiency/usage, injury wrinkles, offensive line issues.
